sql:
WITH reg AS (
  SELECT user_id, CAST(registered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai' AS DATE) AS reg_date
  FROM users
  WHERE CAST(registered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai' AS DATE) >= DATE '2026-01-01'
    AND CAST(registered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai' AS DATE) < DATE '2026-01-08'
),
retained AS (
  SELECT r.user_id
  FROM reg r
  WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM sessions s
    WHERE s.user_id = r.user_id
      AND CAST(s.started_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai' AS DATE) = r.reg_date + INTERVAL 1 DAY
  )
)
SELECT
  (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) FROM reg) AS new_users,
  (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) FROM retained) AS retained_users,
  (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) FROM retained) * 1.0 / NULLIF((SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) FROM reg), 0) AS next_day_retention_rate
